tagline: The fast way to WhatsApp Web.
brief: A fast, low-memory native Windows shell that hosts the official WhatsApp Web client. It should feel fast, native, lightweight and private, and read instantly as messaging without copying WhatsApp's own handset-in-a-bubble.
criteria: Success: reads as messaging + speed in one glance, survives a 16 px favicon, works in one colour, and is clearly not the WhatsApp / Telegram / Signal mark.

concepts.name: Bolt Bubble
concepts.idea: A speech bubble with a lightning bolt knocked out of it — fast chat in one form.
rationale: Messaging (bubble) + speed (bolt) in a single, readable silhouette.
The bolt is real negative space, so the mark stays bold down to 16 px.
Distinct from WhatsApp's handset, Telegram's plane and Signal's bubble.
Green keeps the category cue and matches the app's existing accent.

recommendation: Bolt Bubble — the clearest read of the two core ideas, the strongest at small sizes, and the easiest to extend into an icon set.
next_steps: Apply the mark across the app icon set and in-app surfaces
Set and outline the final wordmark typeface
Trademark check on the product name before public release
